diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~168% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. A few outliers stand out (19 points, ~5% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.236), which favours a robust combination.
